title: ProviderAdapterConfig
description: Common configuration shape for every external-provider adapter (geographic data source, traffic provider, transit feed, push/email notification provider, malware-scanning provider). See docs/architecture/19-deployment-scalability-integration-architecture.md 'External integration boundaries'. Each adapter's runtime config extends this shape via provider_specific.

provider_name.description: Human-readable identifier for this configured provider instance, e.g. 'osm-extract-primary', 'traffic-vendor-a', 'apns-production'.

secret_ref.description: Opaque reference into the secrets manager; never the secret value itself.

fallback_behavior.description: Which documented degradation behavior (23-realtime-navigation-protocol.md failure matrix, 09-geospatial-data-architecture.md) this provider's failure triggers.

provider_specific.description: Provider-specific fields not covered by the shared shape (e.g., an OSM extract's regional coverage list, a push provider's collapse-id support flag). Never leaks into domain logic or the public API contract per 19-...md's adapter boundary rule.
